accounting.rationale: Class paragraph identifies the procedure form; impurity is established by 18.2.3.1.
The Arguments paragraph mixes CPTR/FPTR restrictions, association effects, shape/lower-bound effects, storage-sequence latitude, and case-specific obligations.
The source explicitly makes other association requirements processor dependent.
Examples are informative; concrete executable expectations are taken from p3.
The NOTE describes possible processor-dependent storage-sequence requirements and is not normative; the latitude is recorded under p3 case iii.

review_rationale: Source registration for the Clause 18 heading, 18.1, 18.2, 18.2.1, 18.2.2 (ISO_C_BINDING named constants and derived types), 18.2.3, 18.2.3.1, 18.2.3.2 (C_ASSOCIATED) and 18.2.3.3 (C_F_POINTER) (batch240). Every unit hash-verified by an independent reviewer across two rounds; kind constants are used only under positive guards, and every standardized name is enumerated. Source accounting only.
